verses.25:28: يَٰوَيۡلَتَىٰ لَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أَتَّخِذۡ فُلَانًا خَلِيلࣰ ا

meaning: The root فُلَانٌ (fulān) refers to "such a one" or "so-and-so," used as a placeholder for a person's name, typically male. فُلَانَةٌ (fulānah) is its female equivalent.
